_comment: Example Claude Desktop MCP config for Keep-anywhere. Copy the relevant blocks into your real claude_desktop_config.json (Windows: %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json). Claude Desktop requires STRICT JSON (no comments) — delete this _comment key. Fill secrets from environment, not inline. See dev/scripts/keep-anywhere/README.md.

google-drive._comment: The unifier: reads the Drive 'keep-mirror' folder the Z440 job syncs to. Works on every device that has Claude Desktop. Authenticate per its own README (OAuth).

google-keep-personal._comment: Optional LIVE personal-account access via a community gkeepapi-based Keep MCP. Vet the server source before use — it runs with your Google master token. Replace <keep-mcp-package> with the server you chose.
